limitations: These are original Unit.update controller updates per second, not battles per second.
The explicit component fixture has callback implementations; it is not a complete hero/skill/buff backend.
Every callback and raw-bit formatting observer executes in the timed window, so diagnostic cost is included.
Three alternated, contended trials on the shared four-core environment show substantial variance; no confidence interval or isolated/sustained speedup is established.
Rust arenas retain allocations for each finite trial; complete-battle, GC-lifetime and broad random-corpus qualification remain outstanding.
